correctness.rationale: For each connected graph the two complementary firing phases have exactly product_v c_v compatible chip states; this follows directly from the Laplacian return identity and explicit degree-threshold intervals. On fully subdivided K_n, monochromatic original edges force opposite subdivision colors with weight two, while cross edges independently select one endpoint. Expanding the original-vertex degree factors and excluding mutually selected cross edges by a reciprocal-pair inclusion-exclusion yields the stated quadruple sum for all n>=3. O(n^4) index combinations and polynomial precomputation give the arithmetic bound. Independently, the delivered exact-rational program matches direct cut enumeration at n=3,4,5 and counts through n=8; delivered C++ dynamics enumerates 4096 and 5308416 confined chip states at n=3,4 and obtains 100 and 12312 orbits. All needed computations were rerun from actual delivered-package source paths.

value.rationale: S(K_n) is a canonical incidence graph with n+binom(n,2) vertices and exponentially many firing patterns. The exact invariant counts genuine conserved-chip periodic orbits; compressing the universal exponential cut count to O(n^4) arithmetic terms by a reciprocal-pair obstruction is a substantive new efficient evaluation and gives a reproducible benchmark on a dense-origin graph family. The result is not a routine numeric table or an arbitrary bounded slice.
